instructions_to_main_agent: 1. App Navigation & Auth: Build a responsive sidebar with logo 'Bimbel AELC', navigation links with icons (Lucide icons), dark/light mode toggle, user info, and Logout button. Ensure JWT-based admin authentication flow with clean login form.

2. Dashboard Overview: Include KPI metric cards (Total Siswa, Siswa Aktif, Total Guru, Pendapatan Bulan Ini, Total Invoice Unpaid). Show interactive chart/table for Quick Summary & Upcoming Weekly Classes.

3. Modul 1 - Data Keseluruhan Siswa (Master Data): Build full CRUD table with search, filter (by Program Kelas & Program Bimbel & Status), pagination, and Modal Form with fields: No Urut, Nama, Tanggal Lahir, Kelas, Asal Sekolah, Program Kelas (Junior Regular, Junior Intensive, Super Child Regular, Super Child Intensive), Program Bimbel (Bimbel Global, Bimbel National, Les Mandarin, Les Jari Math Matematika), Biaya (IDR formatted input), No HP/WhatsApp, Status (Active/Inactive).
4. Modul Master Data Guru (Master Data Guru): Build full CRUD table for teachers with Name, Specialization/Subject, Phone/WA, Status, and list of allocated students count.

5. Modul 2 - Data Siswa per Guru: Allocation UI allowing assigning students to teachers. Table with fields: Nama Guru, Nama Siswa, Pertemuan, Biaya, No Invoice, Keterangan Pembayaran (Paid/Unpaid badge). Include filter by Guru and Payment Status with quick toggle paid status button.

6. Modul 3 - Jadwal Siswa: Build dynamic weekly calendar schedule grid (Monday - Friday). Columns: Time (e.g. 14.00-15.00, 15.00-16.00, 16.00-17.00, 17.00-18.00). Rows show Monday to Friday or time slots as rows with Mon-Fri columns. Each slot shows cards displaying No Urut, Nama Siswa, Kelas, Program, and Teacher. Provide modal to add/edit/delete scheduled class.

7. Modul 4 - Invoice Penagihan: Build dynamic invoice generator and printable preview template. Header featuring Bimbel AELC logo & legal entity 'CV ARITA YASA NUSANTARA', Bill To (Student info), Invoice Date, Due Date, Invoice Number (auto-generated e.g. INV-AELC-2026-001). Table detailing items (Program Bimbel, Pertemuan, Fee amount). Payment Method box prominent: Bank BCA a/n CV ARITA YASA NUSANTARA. Include 'Download PDF' button (using html2pdf or window.print formatted print preview) and 'Kirim via WhatsApp' button (generating formatted WA link with prefilled text).

8. Language & Formatting: All text in Indonesian (Rupiah currency formatting e.g. Rp 750.000, Indonesian date format e.g. 24 Februari 2026). Ensure exact data-testid on buttons, inputs, modals, and menu items.
9. Error handling & Feedback: Toast notifications on every CRUD action (Create, Update, Delete, Status change, Invoice generation) using sonner toast.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center }). Use standard responsive left-aligned dashboard layout with sidebar.
DO NOT use raw transparent background on overlays, headers, or dropdowns. Use solid backgrounds or backdrop-blur with minimum opacity.
DO NOT use generic transition: all. Use specific property transitions like transition: color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s, opacity 0.2s.
EVERY interactive element (buttons, links, inputs, selects, tabs, status toggles) MUST have data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Use currency formatting helper function: new Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID', { style: 'currency', currency: 'IDR' }).format(value).
Ensure high contrast on interactive hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
Use shadcn components in /app/frontend/src/components/ui (dialog, select, dropdown-menu, table, input, button, badge, tabs, sonner).
